BL-1231 — 24 main-lane test files declare their tests to node:test, so Vitest collects nothing from them and the unit lane gates commits without ever running their assertions
What it solves: - "[2026-08-28] specifier: measured, not grepped. A naive search for
  `node:test` matches 25 files; Vitest reports exactly 24 as 'No test suite
  found'. The 25th is test/benchmarkNodeTestEvaluator.test.js, which
  contains the string as data because it benchmarks that runner, and which
  collects…
Approval context: One thing needs sign-off: which runner wins. This ticket converts the 24 files to declare their tests to Vitest, because Vitest is what the unit lane runs and a gate that cannot see a file is not a gate. The alternative is to teach the lane to run `node --test` for these files as a second pass, whi…
BL-1231 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1231" (or "reject BL-1231 <reason>") to act.
